mapper.sql: MCUST_NO AS mcustNo , ACNT_SEQ AS acntSeq , CUST_KEY AS custKey , BILL_KEY AS billKey , BANK_GBCD AS bankGbcd , BANK_ACNT_NM AS bankAcntNm , ACNT_NO AS acntNo , LVL_PRTY AS lvlPrty , RGST_ID AS rgstId , RGST_IP AS rgstIp , REG_DTM AS regDtm , CHGP_ID AS chgpId , CHGP_IP AS chgpIp , CHG_DTM AS chgDtm
mapper.select: /* PEAAutoChargeDAO.selectBillingKey */ SELECT MCUST_NO AS mcustNo , CUST_KEY AS custKey , BILL_KEY AS billKey , BANK_GBCD AS bankGbcd , ACNT_SEQ AS acntSeq , ACNT_NO AS acntNo FROM AP_CUST_CHRG_ACNT_MNG WHERE MCUST_NO = #{mcustNo} ORDER BY LVL_PRTY ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

/* PEAAutoChargeDAO.selectPntAutoChrgHisByPaymentKey */ SELECT MCUST_NO AS mcustNo , PAY_KEY AS paymentKey , ORD_ID AS orderId , ACNT_CHRG_AMT AS acntChrgAmt , REAL_CHRG_AMT AS realChrgAmt , ACNT_SEQ AS acntSeq , BANK_GBCD AS bankGbcd , ACNT_NO AS acntNo , BANK_ACNT_NM AS bankAcntNm FROM AP_CUST_PNT_AUTO_CHRG_HIS WHERE MCUST_NO = #{mcustNo} AND PAY_KEY = #{paymentKey} ORDER BY EXEC_DTM DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
